verses.1: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof,
verses.2: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
verses.3: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
verses.4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol
verses.5: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
verses.6: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob.
verses.7: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
verses.8: Who is this King of Glory?, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.9: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
verses.10: Who is He, this King of Glory? — He is the King of Glory. Selah

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
